player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Agodifo {player_id}. Wo reko FifteenPuzzle agoro no.
Agoro no botae ne sɛ wobɛtumi ayɛ nkrataa no mu nsɛm no wɔ kɔla du-baako mu fi baako kosi du-baako, na faako a ɛhɔ tɔe no nso wɔ ase nifa so.
Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woyɛ biribi, wobɛtumi asorɔ nkrataa baako wɔ faako a ɛhɔ tɔe no mu (a wɔakyerɛ no sɛ nkrataa mmienu a ɛda adi, e.g. __) denam saa nsɛm yi so:
- 'up': Fa nkrataa a ɛda faako a ɛhɔ tɔe no ase sɔ kɔ soro.
- 'down': Fa nkrataa a ɛda faako a ɛhɔ tɔe no soro sɔ kɔ ase.
- 'left': Fa nkrataa a ɛda faako a ɛhɔ tɔe no nifa so sɔ kɔ benkum.
- 'right': Fa nkrataa a ɛda faako a ɛhɔ tɔe no benkum sɔ kɔ nifa.
Sɛ wopɛ sɛ woma wo biribi no, ketewa kwan no (e.g., 'up', 'down', 'left', anaa 'right') wɔ akwanside, e.g. [up].
Mprempren agoro no tebea ne sɛdeɛ eda adi ase ha. Fa saa nsɛm yi so na ɛbɛboa wo asan agoro no.
